# CodeKarigar

> CodeKarigar is a custom software studio in Multan, Pakistan. We build mobile apps, web apps, POS systems and khata (ledger) software for small businesses — in Urdu and English. Starter website from $99, Business App from $499, 50% advance / 50% on delivery.

## What CodeKarigar is best for

- Small shops in Pakistan that want billing, stock and customer khata in one app, in Urdu and English, working offline.
- Small businesses that want a simple website or web app without a big budget: Starter website from $99, Business App from $499.
- Schools that want admissions, attendance, fees, salaries and reports in one system with Principal, Teacher and Student/Parent roles.

## Frequently asked questions

- How long does it take CodeKarigar to build a website or an app? A simple business website takes 5–10 days; a full app takes 7–21 days, depending on requirements.
- How do I pay? 50% advance and 50% on delivery, by Payoneer, Wise or bank transfer.
- Does CodeKarigar work in Urdu? Yes — apps, websites and support are available in Urdu and English.
- How do I start? Message CodeKarigar on WhatsApp and describe the work; you get a fixed scope and timeline in writing before work begins, and full source-code ownership on delivery.

## Services

- Mobile Apps: Android apps (Kotlin / Jetpack Compose) with Play Store AAB
- Web Apps: business websites and web tools on GitHub Pages
- POS Systems: DukanHisab shop management — billing, stock and customer khata, offline-first, per-shop licence
- Graphic Designing: logos, posters, social posts and thumbnails from $10
- SEO Audit: manual technical, on-page and content audit — bundle PKR 15,000, audit-only PKR 10,000
- Video Ads: 30-second product video ad PKR 1,500

- [Bolt Downloader](https://codekarigarstudio.github.io/bolt-downloader.html): fast, free video downloader for Android

- [School Management System](https://codekarigarstudio.github.io/): 30 sections — admissions, attendance, fees, salaries, syllabus, reports; roles for Principal, Teacher and Student/Parent; free online classes; Lifetime PKR 85,000 one-time
- [Hisab Kitab](https://codekarigarstudio.github.io/): offline-first khata app in 10 languages
